items.prompt: Which Singapore statute governs the protection of personal data in the private sector?
items.seedAnswer: Section 13 of the Personal Data Protection Act 2012 requires an organisation to obtain consent before collecting, using, or disclosing personal data.
items.adversarialAnswer: Data protection is governed by the Personal Data Protection Act 9999 as held in [2099] SGCA 999.

items.prompt: Which statute defines criminal offences generally in Singapore?
items.seedAnswer: Section 300 of the Penal Code defines murder and prescribes the circumstances in which culpable homicide amounts to murder in Singapore.
items.adversarialAnswer: Criminal offences are defined in the Penal Code 3000 per [2099] SGHC 7777.

items.prompt: Which statute governs the incorporation and administration of companies in Singapore?
items.seedAnswer: The Companies Act 1967 governs the incorporation, administration, and winding up of companies in Singapore.
items.adversarialAnswer: Companies are governed by [2099] SGCA 8888 of the Galactic Republic.

items.prompt: Which statute governs international arbitration seated in Singapore?
items.seedAnswer: The International Arbitration Act 1994 governs international arbitration seated in Singapore and gives effect to the UNCITRAL Model Law.
